# Hierarchy references

- [PMI Work Breakdown Structure practice standard](https://www.pmi.org/standards/work-breakdown-structures) — prior art for deliverable-oriented decomposition and the 100-percent rule.
- [Graphviz DOT documentation](https://graphviz.org/documentation/) — supported automatic tree layout.
- [Mermaid flowchart syntax](https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/flowchart.html) — supported hierarchical graph syntax.

Org-chart and taxonomy semantics are conventions rather than one universal interchange standard. Do not claim a generic tree is an ArchiMate or SysML view without implementing that standard.
